description: Marks the current app as failed when its exit code maps to Failed via the admin-defined return-code table ('[Win32App] lpExitCode is defined as <Failed|Success|SoftReboot|HardReboot|Retry>', Win32AppInstaller.cs). This is the NORMAL mapped-exit-code outcome; the previously matched 'Setting enforcementState as ... Error' line only fires on the rare no-mapping fallback path. The numeric exit code is captured separately by IME-EXITCODE, which precedes this line.
